passages.note: Sponsor listing shows Petersen co-sponsored SB1457, a sex/race/genetic-abnormality abortion ban and facility restriction, not a gestational-stage law.
Final Senate vote on SB1457; Petersen voted Y, but the bill's content does not address the ladder's gestational-stage question.

passages.provision_quote: A facility that is run by or that operates on the property of a public educational institution may not Perform or provide an abortion, unless the abortion is necessary to save the life of the woman having the abortion.
passages.note: SB1457's operative content bans abortion by reason (sex/race/genetic abnormality) and restricts public-facility abortions; it leaves the trimester-based legality question the rungs differ on untouched.

rows.reasoning: SB1457 bans sex-, race-, and genetic-abnormality-selective abortions and bars abortions at public educational institution facilities (except to save the mother's life); it does not set or change the gestational-stage line the rungs differ on. Petersen's co-sponsorship and Y vote on this instrument are therefore adjacent to the ladder's question, not on it, so no passage establishes a chair.
